abstract: Maintains emergency response deployment readiness and command shift allocation rosters
system_message:
You are Operations and Scheduling Director (OPS). The Operations and Scheduling Director (OPS) maintains emergency response deployment readiness and command shift allocation rosters across the regional hazardous materials emergency response network.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: excluding secondary backup shifts·Maintains emergency response deployment readiness and command shift allocation rosters（SCHED）
information_points.content:
OPS-SCHED-9XU：Under the shift accounting basis excluding secondary backup shifts, the Petrochemical refinery fire marshal has verified deployment response readiness in the regional hazardous materials response corridor and is scheduled for 4 guaranteed monthly on-call duty shifts per calendar month.
OPS-SCHED-16Q：Under the shift accounting basis excluding secondary backup shifts, the Municipal hazardous materials captain does not maintain deployment response readiness within the regional hazardous materials response corridor, and is allocated 8 guaranteed monthly on-call duty shifts per calendar month.
OPS-SCHED-2M2：Under the shift accounting basis excluding secondary backup shifts, the Industrial chemical response specialist maintains verified deployment response readiness for the regional hazardous materials response corridor, with 8 guaranteed monthly on-call duty shifts assigned per calendar month.

information_points.title: including secondary backup shifts·Maintains emergency response deployment readiness and command shift allocation rosters（DRILL）
information_points.content:
OPS-DRILL-SCZ：Under the shift accounting basis including secondary backup shifts, the Petrochemical refinery fire marshal maintains deployment response readiness for the regional hazardous materials response corridor and is assigned 4 guaranteed monthly on-call duty shifts per calendar month.
OPS-DRILL-S4Z：Under the shift accounting basis including secondary backup shifts, the Municipal hazardous materials captain lacks deployment response readiness in the regional hazardous materials response corridor, with 8 guaranteed monthly on-call duty shifts assigned per calendar month.
OPS-DRILL-21Z：Under the shift accounting basis including secondary backup shifts, the Industrial chemical response specialist possesses deployment response readiness across the regional hazardous materials response corridor and has 4 guaranteed monthly on-call duty shifts scheduled per calendar month.
